UpdateL3MountTarget.action: This interface is fixed as UpdateL3MountTarget
UpdateL3MountTarget.admissionStatus: When this value is passed, updates the mount target disabled status; pass 1 to disable, 0 to enable; omit to leave the status unchanged
UpdateL3MountTarget.name:
When this value is passed, the mount target name is updated.
  • Supports uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, Chinese characters, half-width colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
  • Must start with an uppercase/lowercase letter or Chinese character, with a length of 1 to 128 English or Chinese characters
  • Cannot be an empty string
  • If not passed, the name will not be changed
UpdateL3MountTarget.accessGroupName: When this value is passed, updates the bound access group; omit to leave unchanged
